name: AECOM Women in STEM Bachelor of Engineering Scholarship
summary: Up to $8,500 for female penultimate-year Griffith engineering students with a GPA of 5 or above.
key: Maximum value is $8,500, paid in instalments.
who: Full-time in the penultimate year of the Bachelor of Engineering (Honours), including double degrees.
Not receiving any other Griffith scholarship.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Closed and awarded for 2026; listed as coming soon for 2027.
